text.text_excerpt: I've wandered past this spot many times and never stopped in. But a friend was having a party here on Friday night so away I went. It's a great neighborhood bar. Not too fancy and drinks are affordable. Everyone was super friendly... even when I knocked over a box of empty liquor bottles with my giant purse. Not sure why there were boxes of empties taking up floor space, but there you go. There's a big projection tv that had sports and random TV showing, maybe by bartender preference/patron request. Great spot to hang out and visit.

This bar is kind of weird in a good way. I've always seen it across the street from Mimi's but never ventured in until some friends invited me to Cutter's "gay night". I'm not sure if Cutter's is a gay bar all the time or just once a week, but the crowd definitely got poppin' and everyone there was cute! It was a little hipster, not that that was surprising, but it was still super fun. They had a random table of free clothing and old school porn videotapes for the taking, which people happily perused. The DJ was awesome, bathrooms were clean, drinks were reasonable. Overall this was a cool spot. I don't know if I'd make this my watering hole, but it is worth checking out.

I love this place. One of the sweetest lil neighborhood bars I've (literally) stumbled upon. It is more of a gay bar, but all kinds of people hang out. I've never felt uncomfortable or unwelcome. The bartenders are quite the characters, but super efficient, and the bar patrons are friendly and funny. The bathrooms are clean and they play some awesome jams. Cheap drinks, cold beer. Come for Trivia Night, Tuesdays at 7pm. Guaranteed good time!
